body:
Cactykes work with the people of the dunes to bring cool, life-sustaining water to those in need.

Monster Trainer Spells
Monstorin Stats

CACTYKE
CR 4

XP 1,200
N Small plant
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 15, flat-footed 18 (+4 Dex, +7 natural, +1 size)
hp 40 (9d8) Fort +6; Ref +7; Will +5
Defensive Abilities bleed; DR 5/slashing; Immune plant traits; Resist electricity 5, fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 2 slams +11 (1d3, plus bleed)
Special Attacks bleed (1 damage)

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 19, Con 10, Int 13, Wis 15, Cha 14
Base Atk +6; CMB +5; CMD 19
Feats Combat Reflexes, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +13, Perception +14, Stealth +17 (+21 in desert terrain); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth in desert terrain
Languages Common
SQ desert stride

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bleed (Ex)

When a cactus warrior successfully attacks or is attacked by a creature in melee, that creature takes 1 bleed damage. This damage is cumulative, but all bleed damage from one cactus warrior can be healed by a single DC 15 Heal check. Magical healing stops the bleeding immediately.

Desert Stride (Ex)

Cactus warriors can move through any sort of desert-related difficult terrain at their full movement rate without taking any penalties or suffering any damage. Magical enchantments designed to impede movement in such conditions still affect them.
